summary.en: Post durable owner-scoped notifications and dismiss this App's own records through the OS Notification Service.
Persist a notification, queue enabled delivery channels, and return its durable string id. Delivery is not user acknowledgement.

label.en: Non-empty headline shown by the notification daemon.
Optional body text shown below the summary.
Sender name shown in the popup; empty or omitted uses Claw OS Agent.
Icon-theme name only (up to 128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens). Paths and URLs are unsupported.
Popup timeout: -1 uses the desktop default, 0 never expires, positive values are milliseconds (at most 2147483647). Durable OS activity is retained.
Omit the desktop history copy. The authoritative OS activity record is still durably retained.
Optional bounded replay key, scoped to this App and owner; repeated posts update one record within 15 minutes.

why.en: Send a desktop notification to the user.

summary.en: Dismiss this App's durable notification and close its desktop presentation. Legacy desktop numeric ids are not accepted.

label.en: Durable notif- string id returned by notify.post for this owner and App.
